scope: post-hoc controlled experiments on historically exposed Apartment and Cubicle
query_sets: reuse every frozen positive and opposite-direction negative query

upstream_baseline.name: VGGT-SLAM-style Top-1 objects + explicit relation adapter
upstream_baseline.segmentation: same cached SAM 3 noun-phrase prompt and 0.50 threshold as multi-view
upstream_baseline.lifting: all Top-1 masks, finite-only homogeneous transform + upstream PCA; no robust-point gate
upstream_baseline.prompt_boundary: shared frozen task-to-noun-phrase mapping; not a verbatim end-to-end upstream reproduction

representative_center: select within each already clustered object; never use GT to select observations
candidate_quality: maximum observation geometric-mean retrieval/SAM/valid-point quality; no support-count confidence inflation

reasoning.reference_selection: independent of requested relation, lexical Jaccard times candidate quality
reasoning.target_selection: filter direction-incompatible candidates before ranking by lexical Jaccard times candidate quality
reasoning.equivalence_rule: complete-link candidate groups requiring both center distance and AABB overlap; query-level only, no memory rewrite
reasoning.final_abstention: missing entity, insufficient entity match score, or no direction-compatible target; no score-gap veto

main_comparison: top1_pca vs a2_pe under identical filter_with_entity_guard adapter; report check_after_selection too
label_access: prediction inputs contain candidates, anchor poses, and queries only; GT and Sim3 are evaluator-only

reporting.pair_dependency_warning: queries share underlying objects; gains are not independent trials

supplement.name: fixed-candidate coarse-category relational disambiguation
supplement.scope: separate diagnostic; not native upstream end-to-end coarse-category retrieval
supplement.query_rule: each family x every other eligible reference task x four directions; retain unique-positive or all-negative cases with every GT center separated by at least 0.25m on that axis
supplement.eligibility: all family members and reference have one official GT OBB; no filtering by model success
supplement.alias_rule: declared category membership from task names, shared by every method; no learned or GT-derived semantic classifier
supplement.report: all queries, family/task breakdown, paired selection wins/losses, failed candidate cases retained

revision_reason: v1 target/reference score-gap rejection suppressed valid alternatives; retain it as a negative ablation and use the pre-existing entity evidence floor plus hard relation compatibility in v2
